description: Check observed listings before recommending or adding any pack. For garlic cloves, send approvedBulbForCloves only for the precise SKU and clove count the shopper accepted. Its printed UK per-item rate may stand for one bulb when it equals its selling price and no count conflicts. Submit kitchen cutting instructions unchanged; Chop it removes a trailing cut size when matching. For measured plain lemon or lime juice, submit the original ingredient, amount and unit. Chop it converts it to whole fruit. Only an explicitly bottled requirement can use a bottle. Send the shop’s progress reference as runId and each line’s own lineId from the shopping list (the shopper’s card marks it found), its exact selected buying target and actual product identifier, title, printed pack size, numeric price in local currency and number already in the trolley. Never guess a missing value. For dry rice with no form on the title, include the retailer’s printed dryRiceEvidence from the product description or hob instructions. For cooked rice, send printed cookedRiceEvidence that the pouch is already cooked when the shelf title only says microwave. packs is the total target and packsToAdd is the remaining number for that product. For meat, fish or shellfish bought by weight, packs leaves out the last pack when the others cover at least 80% of the amount: add that number and no more. Choose one eligible pack, add the missing quantity and verify all additions in the final trolley read; never add all matches. Always preserve the requested form in the target even when using shorter shelf searches. Returns eligible product identifiers and pack counts. Counted items minimise surplus first. Comparable matches rank by closest wording then total pack cost. For fluid ounces or pints, supply the equivalent metric size only when printed on the pack. Use the visible count on the label for a multipack, for example 4 per pack. Check all requested quality or certification details before use. An empty match means leave the line unresolved. Never recommend an unreturned product. Does not visit or change the trolley. When searching a live shelf, look past the first three. Inspect up to 12 distinct listings first, or all results if fewer exist. If only oversized packs fit or none fits, search for the exact form (such as loose lemon), scrolling up to three more screens and considering up to 40 unique listings in total for the ingredient. Send all observed candidates together for that line. Set searchScope to more_available, exhausted or limit_reached for a live search, and supplied_labels only for shopper-provided examples. If the checker asks for more results, continue before recommending or adding. If only a multipack is eligible, state how many items it contains. Never invent listings to reach a count.

approvedBulbForCloves.description: Only for the single fresh garlic bulb the shopper explicitly chose for this exact number of garlic cloves. Keep the original clove target.

frozen.description: True when the shelf or product page marks the product frozen, whether or not its title says so.

packCount.description: The number of items the pack states, when its size is a weight, such as 4 for “4 Chicken Breast Fillets 640g”.

printedClaims.description: Claims printed on the product page but not in its title, word for word, such as “Suitable for vegetarians”.

searchScope.description: Report whether the live search has more results, ended, or reached the three-scroll or 40-result limit. Use supplied_labels only for a supplied set.

runId.description: The progress reference of this shop. Its card then marks these lines found. Send it with every pack check.
